Commentary.Commentary: Bangladesh did a good job in the field, barring the last 10 overs. That has cost them big and now there will be extra pressure on their batting to overhaul a target of 295. Shafiul Islam was the pick of the bowlers, however, he suffered at the death. Soumya Sarkar continued to impress with the ball and finished with a 3-wicket haul. It's a pitch where stroke-making is not easy once the balls get old. Hence, the start will be the key for Bangladesh. Let's see how the chase pans out. Do join us in a short while.

A strong batting show from the Islanders in their quest to clean sweep the Bangla Tigers. The star of the last match, Avishka Fernando flopped today but the rest of the top batsmen stepped up. They kept on forming partnerships and in spite of Bangladesh tightening the screws in the middle overs, the hosts managed to find a way to score runs. Karunaratne and Perera did an excellent job up front and then Mathews along with Mendis formed a century partnership. All these efforts would have meant nothing though had Dasun Shanaka not provided the impetus.

A quick interview with Angelo Mathews. He says that it was hot and humid and this is for what they work extremely hard. Tells that this is the best wicket of the series and feels that they have got a very good score. Wants his team to bowl and field well and defend it now. Adds that once the ball gets old, it stops a bit onto the bat. Praises the knocks of Karunaratne, Perera and Mendis and once again says that they have put a good score on the board.

106 runs in the last 10 overs and it's a very big finish from Sri Lanka. It all started with the cameo from Dasun Shanaka and his quickfire partnership with Angelo Mathews. Bangladesh's bowlers completely lost the plot as the hosts lifted their final score to close to 300.

FOUR! Brilliant finish to the innings for Sri Lanka. The third man is up but still Sarkar goes short. Hasaranga just guides it over short third man for a boundary. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 294/8 IN THEIR 50 OVERS.

DROPPED AND FOUR! What an effort from Sabbir! Fuller on middle and leg, Hasaranga lofts it over mid on. It goes to the right of long on. Sabbir there, moves to that side and almost takes a blinder over and across his head. He though cannot hold onto it as unluckily for him the ball slips from his hands, falls in front of the rope before touching it.
Slower bouncer. Hasaranga looks to play the upper cut but misses.

No hat-trick for Sarkar but he has made a mess of it. This should have been a run out. Full on the pads, Hasaranga flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and calls for two straightaway. Rajitha responds but he knows that he is in trouble at the bowler's end. Sarkar collects the throw before the stumps but he is unaware where the stumps are and misses.
Kasun Rajitha is the next batsman in but it will be Wanindu Hasaranga on strike.

OUT! Dananjaya holes out! Two in two for Sarkar and now he is on a hat-trick. Fuller ball outside off, Akila looks to clear sweeper cover but he does not time it well and ends up hitting it straight to the man there. Sabbir stationed at sweeper cover takes a very easy catch.
Akila Dananjaya is the new batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Mathews' brilliant knock comes to an end. Full and wide outside off but this time it is inside the tramline. Mathews swings his bat at it but gets a thin outside edge behind. Mushfiqur puts a huge appeal, Sarkar too is confident in fact he is so sure he does not even look at the umpire and has his right hand up in celebration. Mathews looks to walk back but seeing the umpire is unmoved, he stays. Bangladesh take the review and the replays confirm that there is a feather on it.

Huge shout for a caught behind! The keeper is appealing, the bowler has his right arm raised as he walks forward in celebration. The umpire though is unmoved. Review taken. The Ultra Edge has found something.
WIDE! Poor start. Sarkar bowls it way outside off, on the wrong side of the tramline and it has been wided.
Soumya Sarkar to bowl the final over of the innings.
Full on middle, Hasaranga playing his first ball lofts it over extra cover. The man from long off cleans it up. Two runs taken. Mathews will be on strike for the last over. 12 runs came off the over.
Hit hard towards sweeper cover for a single.
Wanindu Hasaranga is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Jayasuriya departs. Full ball outside off, Shehan was looking to make room and hit it over covers. He does not time it well and it goes behind cover. Skipper, Tamim Iqbal there moves behind and takes a well judged catch.
FOUR! Fuller ball but on the leg side, Jayasuriya says thank you very much and flicks it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Mathews hops away on the off side and squeezes this full ball wide of point for a single.
FOUR! Excellent start!
Shorter on off, Mathews punches it towards covers for a single. Another good over for Sri Lanka. 11 runs off it.
SIX! This is out of here. Flatter on middle and leg, Mathews moves away and smokes it over the long on fence for a huge hit.
Short on off, SJ punches it towards covers for a single.

Comfortably in. Shorter on off, Mathews pushes it towards cover and calls for a quick run. Shehan responds swiftly. The fielder throws it at the keeper's end and Mushfiqur takes off the bails. Jayasuriya looks to be in but the square leg umpire takes it upstairs and the replay shows Shehan was in.
Run Out appeal taken upstairs. Jayasuriya looks to be in but let's see what the replays have to say.
Flatter on off, Shehan runs it down to third man for a single.
Full toss on middle and leg, Mathews hits it hard but there is a man at deep mid-wicket so just a single.

Good comeback from Shafiul! A low full toss wide outside off, Shehan goes hard at it but fails to get it from the middle of his bat. It rolls back to the bowler who slides and then has a shy at the striker's end. Misses as Shehan runs back inside his crease. Eventful over, 9 runs and a wicket from it.

SIX! Just over! Jayasuriya comes down the track on the second ball of his innings and lofts this over the cover fence for a maximum. Mohammad Mithun at deep gets a hand on it but cannot keep it in. First six in ODI cricket for Shehan.
Stroked to point for one.
Flicked away to get off the mark.
Good length ball on off, Mathews pushes it towards cover.
Shehan Jayasuriya is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Sabbir does not make any mistake this time. Shanaka's cameo comes to an end. Shafiul bowls it full outside off, he though takes the pace off this one. Shanaka looks to go over long off but gets no timing on it. He ends up skying it just outside the circle at mid off. Sabbir comes running in from long off and takes a very good catch diving forward. Brilliant from Sabbir!
Knocks it down to long on for a run. 10 from the over, 30 in the last two, Sri Lanka are going great guns!
Quicker and on middle, shorter in length, Mathews punches it from the back foot to mid-wicket for one.

FOUR! Time to punish for that dropped catch! Quicker, flatter and fuller outside off, Mathews throws all his power behind his shot and swats it down the ground for a boundary at long off. 50-run stand comes up in only 25 balls!

DROPPED BY SABBIR! Tossed up ball landing full on middle, Mathews opens his stance and tries to heave it over the leg side. But he fails to middle his shot and it balloons in the air off the top edge. Sabbir sprints forward from long on, gets to the ball but fails to catch it. Costly miss, that. Two taken by the batsmen.
Flighted and on middle and leg, Dasun flicks it through square leg for a single.
Flatter delivery, a full toss on the pads, hit firmly through mid-wicket for a run.
Mehedi Hasan is back into the attack.

SIX! Shanaka started the over with a biggie and he has ended this one with a maximum too. Shafiul bowls full outside off, Shanaka comes down the track and smashes it over the long on fence for a biggie. Brilliant over for Sri Lanka. 20 runs off it.
Full on off, Mathews glances it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slower delivery outside the off stump, Shanaka pushes it to long on for a single.
Another full delivery outside the off stump, Dasun plays an expansive drive towards extra cover for a brace. Shanaka will feel he missed out as it was there to be hit but he can only take two.

FOUR! 10 runs off the first two balls in this over. Shanaka has come with an aggressive intent. It is wide outside off, Shanaka once again comes inside the line and smashes it through covers for a boundary. Pressure on the bowler.
SIX! Shafiul is welcomed to his new spell with a biggie. Shafiul bowls it fuller outside off, Shanaka shuffles across and deposits it over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Shafiul Islam is back. He has been one of the best bowlers in this innings.
On top of middle, Mathews punches it towards cow corner and gets a couple.
FOUR! Brilliant execution! He was expecting that off cutter to be full and it was. It is on off, Mathews gets down on one knee and slogs it over backward square leg for a boundary.
Full delivery on the off stump, Dasun moved across the off stump and flicks it towards mid on for another single.
Slower delivery outside the off stump, Mathews gets an inside edge while playing a drive and it rolls towards third man. The batsmen cross for a single.
Full delivery on off stump, Dasun plays a wristy shot for a single.
FOUR! Well controlled pull from Shanaka! His first in the game. Sarkar bowls a slower bouncer, Shanaka picks it early and pulls it through fine leg for a boundary.
Sign of real aggression here. Good length ball outside off, Mathews comes down the track and hits it hard but straight to the man at covers.
Another full delivery  on middle, Shanaka plays the flick shot toward square leg and takes a single.
Fuller in length this time on middle, Shanaka gets a thick outside edge while playing the flick and the ball goes towards deep extra cover for a brace.
On a good length on off, Mathews pushes it to mid on and takes a quick single.
Shortish in length on the leg stump, Mathews moving inside his crease can only defend it back to the bowler.

EDGED AND FOUR! A rather streaky shot to bring up his 40th ODI fifty. A bit lucky but he has played well. He gets to his milestone off a leading edge. Good length ball on off, Mathews looks to flick but the ball goes off the leading edge towards the vacant slip region for a boundary.
Rubel Hossain is back on!
Back of a length delivery outside off, Shanaka looks to cut but misses the ball. Good over for Bangladesh. A wicket and 3 runs from it.
On a good length this time, Mathews flicks it towards deep mid-wicket for a single. Brings up the 200 for the Lankans
Slow short ball on the middle stump, Mathews just pushes it back to the bowler.
Dasun Shanaka is the next batsman in.

OUT! Caught! Sabbir has taken a very good catch here. End of a fine knock from Mendis, he will be disappointed not to stay there till the end. The golden-arm of Sarkar has taken time to strike but he has done it eventually. Soumya bowls a slower ball outside off, Kusal looks to heave it over long on but he does not pick it up early. Sabbir runs behind to his left and judges it to perfection to take a very good catch inside the ropes at widish long on. The 101-run stand is broken. Much-needed wicket for Bangladesh.
Good length ball outside off, Mathews punches it towards cover for a single.

Very well bowled but good running too from Mathews. Sarkar bowls a yorker outside off. Mendis gets his bat down in time to dig it out. He looks at Mathews who calls for a single and they get it quickly. Brings the 100-run stand between the two.
Soumya Sarkar is back into the attack.
Short ball on off, Mathews punches it cover.
Shorter on off, Mathews tucks it with soft hands towards deep mid-wicket and gets a couple. This is his experience that is counting. He is making use of the ground dimensions here.
Another short ball on the middle stump, Mathews just pushes it back to the bowler.
Shorter in length and on the off stump, Mathews cuts it towards point. No run.
Flatter delivery on middle, Mendis flicks it to square leg and takes a single. Mendis is interested for two but is sent back.

SIX! What a way to bring up your fifty! Tossed up on middle, Mendis gets down on one knee and slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a maximum to bring up his 16th ODI fifty. He raises his bat and soaks in all the applause as the home fans go up in joy.
Powerplay 3 time! Now a maximum of 5 fielders can be placed outside the ring till the end of this innings.
Good length ball on the leg stump, Mendis pushes it towards mid on and  takes a single. Mendis will keep strike for the next over. Partnership moves to 89.
On a good length this time, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket for another dot.
On the pads, Mendis flicks it but straight to mid-wicket.
OH! That one didn't  bounce much. Slower ball outside off, Mendis premeditates that he would go to the on side. The ball though stays low and Mendis misses his pick up shot.
Hits the deck hard around off, Mathews taps it to backward point for a single.
Fuller ball on off and middle, Mendis nudges it to long on for a single.
Rubel Hossain is back.
Loopy delivery on middle stump, Mathews defends it back to the bowler.
Another short ball on the leg stump, Mendis rocks back and pulls it to square leg for a single.
Shortish in length on the off stump, Mendis cuts but straight to the point fielder.
Loopy delivery on the middle pole, Mendis comes down the track and plays it back to the bowler.
Flighted on the stumps, Kusal blocks it off the front foot.
Floated on off, Mendis looks to defend but it goes towards cover-point off the outer half of his bat. The key there was Mendis played it with soft hands. A single is taken.
Taijul Islam is back on.
Slower and full delivery aimed at middle stump, Mathews pushes it to mid on for a single.

FOUR! Lady luck continues to evade Bangladesh! Shafiul steams in and bowls a good length ball around off. It moves away just a bit. Mathews looks to defend but ends up getting a thick outside edge. It goes through the man at backward point and onto the fence. That ball did not deserve to go to the fence.
Another good length delivery on the middle this time, Mathews just flicks it towards the deep mid-wicket region and calls Mendis for a couple. Excellent running between the wickets from these two.
On a good length around the off stump, Mendis guides it to third man for a single.
Fuller on off, this one sticks on the surface and comes to the batsman. Mendis pushes it off the upper half of his bat towards mid off.
Good length ball on off, Mathews flat-bats it towards long on for one. It comes off the inner half but Mathews never looked in danger.
Short ball on middle, Mathews flicks it towards the leg side for another single.
Good length ball on the middle pole, Mendis pushes it to mid on for a single. The mid-wicket fielder tries to make a diving stop but it goes past him allowing the batsmen to cross.

In the air...but safe!  Luck seems to be going Sri Lanka's way here. Fuller ball on off, Mathews looks to loft it over mid on but ends up getting a leading edge. Luckily for him the ball falls wide of sweeper cover at no man's land.
Another one on a good length on the middle stump, Mendis pulls it towards the leg side and takes a single.
On a good length this time, Kusal defends it back to the bowler.
Short ball outside off stump, Mendis hanging back at the crease cuts it past the point fielder for a brace.
Length delivery on middle, Mathews flicks it to mid-wicket.
On a length on off, Angelo plays it to covers.
Good length delivery on off, Mathews keeps it out.
On a length on off, Mendis guides it towards third man for a run.
DROPPED! Good length delivery on middle, Mathews looks to flick but gets an inside edge. It goes towards Mushfiqur Rahim where he looks to take the catch but spills it. The batsmen cross ends.
FOUR! Poor delivery from Shafiul Islam. He angles it down the leg side, Mathews flicks it easily towards fine leg for a boundary.
Shafiul Islam is back on!

Drinks Break! After scalping two wickets in quick succession, Sri Lanka's run rate went down but Mathews and Kusal Mendis have steadied the ship here. The two have stitched a 64-run stand and though they started off slowly, they are now accelerating. Sri Lanka will hope that these two bat till the end and take them close to 270. Tamim Iqbal needs to find a way to break this stand and get back on top.
Now follows it up with a good, solid back foot defense. 9 runs off Rubel's returning over.

EDGED AND FOUR! This game is cruel on the bowlers at times. This is not a bad ball from Rubel. It is outside off and nips back in. Mendis looks to defend but ends up getting a fat outside edge. There is no slip and the ball races away from there to the fence.
Good length ball on off, Mathews punches it to cover-point and gets a single.
On a good length on off, Mathews keeps it out.
Good length delivery on off, Mathews blocks it off the back foot.
FOUR! Welcomes Rubel with a boundary. On a length on middle, Mathews lofts it over mid on for a boundary. Not the start Rubel would have been looking for in his new spell.
Rubel Hossain is back for another burst!
Tossed up on middle, Mathews punches it to long on for a run.
Loopy delivery on middle, Mendis comes down the track and hits it over mid-wicket. The batsmen take a run.
Flighted delivery on off, Mathews punches it towards point. The batsmen cross ends.
Floated delivery on off, Mathews punches it to mid on.
Tossed up on middle, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mathews flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Mathews glances it to square leg and keeps the strike.
Full on middle and leg, Mendis nudges it to long on for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Mendis looks to cut but gets a thick outside edge. He played it with soft hands and hence it goes to the keeper on the bounce.
Full toss outside off, Mathews looks to play it on the off side but ends up french cutting it to square leg for a single. Really lucky, could have easily dragged it on.
Brilliant ball. A very low full toss outside off, Mathews looks to play but misreads the swing.
Slower and full around off, Mathew plays it to mid on.
FOUR! Second boundary of the over. Tossed up delivery on middle and leg, Mendis sweeps it through mid-wicket for a boundary. There was no chance for the fielder there. 9 runs have come from the over.
Loopy delivery on middle, Mendis flicks it to mid-wicket.
Flighted delivery on off, Mendis blocks it off the back foot.

FOUR! Excellent shot. Floated delivery on middle, Mendis sweeps it through square leg for a boundary. Sri Lanka are building a good partnership here and it is a much-needed one for them. They would target close to 270 from here.
Full delivery on middle, Mendis drives it back towards the bowler.
Tossed up on off, Mathews plays it towards point for a single.
Mehedi Hasan is back into the attack.
Single to end the over. On the pads, Taijul glances it to the on side for a single.
Tossed up around off, Mathews pushes it to cover.
On the pads, Mendis flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
Follows it up with a solid front foot defense.

FOUR! Welcome boundary for Sri Lanka! A poor ball from Taijul. It is down the leg side, Mendis gets down on one knee and paddle sweeps it through fine leg for a boundary. A boundary after more than 6 overs.
Floated on off, Mendis defends it from right under his eyes.
Short of a length delivery, Mathews pulls it to mid-wicket. Just 4 runs have come from the over.
Full on off, Mathews looks to drive but gets a leading edge on it. It goes through covers. The batsmen get two runs.
On a good length on off, Angelo plays it to point.
Good length delivery on off, Mathews keeps it out.
Length delivery on off, Mendis punches it towards point for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Mathews flicks it through square leg for a single.
Short on off, Mathews makes room and cuts it towards point. The batsmen change ends.
Tossed up on middle, Mathews drives it back towards the bowler.
Short on off, Mendis looks to guide but gets an outside edge. It goes towards third man for a run.
Floated delivery on off, Mathews plays it towards covers for a run.
Tossed up on off, Angelo drives it to covers.
Flighted delivery on middle, Mathews defends it off the back foot.
Full on middle, Mathews drives it to long on for a single.
Length delivery on middle, Mendis flicks it towards square leg for a single.
On a length on middle, Mendis flicks it to the leg side.
Good length delivery on middle, Mathews looks to defend but gets a leading edge on it. It went all along the ground towards point. The batsmen cross ends.
Length delivery on off, Mendis dabs it towards third man for a run.
On a good length on middle, Mendis pushes it back towards the bowler.
Short on off, Mendis punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Flighted on off, Mendis pushes it to mid off.

OH! The feather saves him. Floated on off, Mendis looks to play the sweep but ends up getting a slight inside edge onto his pads. There is a stifled appeal but no is the call from umpire. Had he missed it completely, Mendis would have been plumb in front.
Floated on off, Mathews nudges it to the left of cover and takes one.
Flatter around off, Mathews pushes it uppishly but wide of short cover.
Short on off, Mendis gets on one knee and pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Another short ball on the off stump, Mendis just guides it to third man for another single. These two are rotating the strike very well here.
Shortish in length this time, Mathews hangs back and pushes it to deep cover for a single.
Good length ball on middle and off, Mendis milks it down to long on for an easy single.
Back of a length delivery on the middle stump, Mendis flicks it to short fine leg for a dot ball.
Shortish in length this time, Mendis cuts it to point. No run.

SAFE! It was full delivery from Soumya on middle stump, Mendis tries to play an expansive drive over the bowler's head but the bat twists in his hands and he mistimes it in the air. The ball falls just outside the reach of the mid off fielder.
Soumya Sarkar is back on.
Tossed up on the stumps, Mathews keeps it out. Maiden for Taijul. He has bowled really well here.
Floated on off, AM blocks it.
Short on middle and leg, Mathews pulls it hard but straight to mid-wicket.
Loopy on middle, Angelo blocks it off the front foot.
Floated on middle, Mathews glances it to mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, Mathews defends it off the front foot.
FOUR! What a shot! Too short from Rubel this time and Mendis just rocks back and pulls it with disdain for his first boundary. It was a good over until then but eventually 11 runs came off it.
Fuller in length this time on the middle stump, Mathews plays it towards mid-wicket and takes a single.

EDGED AND FOUR! Bangladesh were so close to seeing the back of Angelo Mathews. Fuller ball outside off, Mathews goes chasing after it with very little foot movement. He ends up getting a thick outside edge which goes just wide of the diving Mahmudullah at first slip. Rubel was inches away from getting his second of the game.
Good length ball on fourth stump line, Mendis flicks it towards mid-wicket and takes  a single.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery from Hossain. Back of a length delivery outside the off stump,  Mendis plays at it but the ball just misses the edge. Extra bounce evident.
Good length ball outside the off stump, Mathews drives it uppishly towards deep cover for a single. It was in the air for a while but nowhere near the fielder.
On middle and leg, Mathews flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single to get off the mark. Brings up the 100 for Sri Lanka.
Floated on the stumps, Mathews keeps it away. Mushfiqur likes it and says 'lovely' from behind the stumps.
Loopy ball on off, Mathews strokes it back to the bowler.
Flighted on off, Mathews defends it with a straight bat.
Slower through the air on middle, Kusal flicks it off the inner half of his bat towards square leg for a single.
Flighted on off, Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Fuller this time from Rubel on the middle pole, Angelo attempts to flick but gets a thick outside edge towards mid on. Great over comes to an end for Bangladesh. A wicket maiden.
Shortish in length outside off stump, Angelo blocks it out towards the off side for another dot.
On a good length this time on the middle, Mathews defends it towards cover.
BEATEN! Excellent delivery first up to Mathews. It was bowled short on fourth stump, Mathews attempts to fend it but ends up missing it altogether.
Angelo Mathews walks out to bat next. A slip in place for him.

OUT! Caught! Two wickets in quick succession and both the set batsmen are out of here. Rubel steams in and bowls a 134 kph ball outside off. Perera goes chasing after it but ends up getting a feather on it to the keeper. Mushfiqur Rahim takes another regulation catch. So, Perera follows Karunaratne back to the pavilion and now Sri Lanka have two new batsmen at the crease. Bangladesh will look to capitalize here.
Shortish in length way outside off stump, Perera reaches for the cut and gets an inside edge towards point. No run.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack.
On the stumps, KM blocks it off the front foot.
Floated on the stumps, Mendis defends it off the front foot.
Shorter on off, Perera cuts it to point for a single.
Mendis is off the mark straightaway. Floated on off, Mendis strokes it wide of mid off and gets a single.
Kusal Mendis is the next batsman in.

OUT! Very tame dismissal for Dimuth Karunaratne. The fine leg is up inside the circle so Taijul was not going to offer a lot of pace. He bowls it slow on off, Karunaratne looks to play the paddle scoop. He gets no timing on it and ends up looping it up behind the stumps. Mushfiqur takes the simplest of catches. These shots, when they come off, look good but when they don't, it makes the batsman look stupid. A very good partnership between Perera and Karunaratne comes to an end in a very soft way.
Short on off, Perera pulls it to the left of deep mid-wicket. Sabbir there gets to the ball and keeps it down to one.
Another loopy delivery on the middle this time, Karunaratne comes down the track and plays it straight back to the bowler.
Loopy delivery on the off stump. DK prods forward and pushes it to cover. Better delivery from Mahmudullah.

The physio is out in the middle having a check on Perera. Spray is being applied. Sri Lanka will hope that it is not a major blow and Perera can continue his good work here. Bandage applied to his right hand and he is good to go...

OUCH! Mahmudullah loops it outside off, Perera comes down the track and nudges it to point. Kusal takes off for a quick single, Sabbir has a shy at the bowler's end but the ball hits Perera on his right hand. He takes off his glove and goes down in pain.

FOUR! Great batting from Perera. It was a loopy delivery on the fourth stump, Kusal moves towards the off side and sweeps it hard towards the square leg fence. The fielder at deep mid-wicket tries to stop it but it goes past him for a four. Sri Lanka looking to up the ante now.
Loopy delivery on the middle pole, Kusal comes down the track and pushes it towards mid-wicket. No run.
Short around middle and off, Perera pulls it wide of deep mid-wicket and gets a couple.

Drinks Break! Sri Lanka have recovered well. They lost Avishka Fernando early but skipper, Karunaratne and Kusal Perera have done well after that. They have set themselves and at the same time have punished the bad balls. The duo has added 75 runs so far and will look to continue their good work. Bangladesh need a way to break this stand here.
Loopy delivery on the middle stump, Karunaratne punches it to cover. No run.
Another short one on middle stump, Perera flicks it to deep mid-wicket and takes a single.
Shortish in length on the off stump, Perera punches it off the back foot straight to the cover fielder.
Beautifully bowled. Taijul gives it air around off, Perera looks to defend but gets an outside edge towards short third man.
Flatter delivery on the middle pole, Dimuth flicks it to square leg for a single.
Full delivery on the middle pole, Perera dances down the track and takes a single.
Taijul Islam is back on.
Shorter on off, Dimuth punches it to cover.
Floated on off, Karunaratne strokes it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle and leg, Karunaratne flicks it but finds short mid-wicket.
Short ball around off, Perera punches it wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
Tossed up on off, Perera comes down the track and nudges it to long on for a single.
Floated outside off, Perera sweeps it but finds short fine leg.
Good length ball on off stump, DK defends it towards the off side.

Fuller this time on the off pole, Perera attempts to drive but gets an inside edge and the ball rolls towards the leg side. They take a single. Perera does not know where the ball has gone and looks for it before Dimuth calls him for a single.
FOUR! Hammered away! Slower ball around off. Kusal comes down the track and smacks it through covers for a boundary.
Another short ball on the off stump, Karunaratne flicks it again towards square leg for a single.
Back of a length delivery on the middle stump, Dimuth flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and the batsmen take two.

OHH! Good length ball outside the off stump. It kept low resulting in Karunaratne missing the ball completely while trying to defend it. Dimuth is lucky to survive as the ball missed the off stump by a whisker.
Once again follows the boundary with a single to long off. 12 runs off the over. Expensive start for Mahmudullah.
FOUR! Another short ball from Mahmudullah. He has struggled here for his line and length. It is on middle and leg, Karunaratne pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted on off, Perera sweeps it to square leg for a single.
Now milks it down to long off and gets a single.
FOUR! Poor from Mahmudullah. He bowls it from a wide angle but ends up serving it short on the pads, Karunaratne gets on his back foot and pulls it through backward square leg for a boundary.
WIDE! Short and down the leg side. Dimuth lets it be and it brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
Starts with a slower ball in the air on middle. Karunaratne tucks it to mid-wicket.
Mahmudullah is into the attack now.
Another one on the pads, DK flicks it away to the leg side for a single.
Shortish ball on the pads, Perera pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Shortish in length outside off, KP guides it to cover. No run.

Huge appeal for LBW but turned down by the umpire. It's on a good length this time on the leg stump line, Perera goes for a hoick but misses and gets hit on the pads. Tamim is asking the keeper should they review it but he gets a negative reply. Good decision as the Ball Tracker shows the ball was pitching outside leg.
Shortish in length, Dimuth rocks back and plays it towards the leg side for a single.
Good length delivery on the middle pole, Dimuth tries to flick but gets an inside edge onto the pads. There is a stifled appeal for an LBW but not given.
Rubel Hossain is back into the attack.
Almost chopped on! Short around off, Perera looks to cut but gets an inside edge. Luckily it bounces in front of the crease and goes away from the stumps.
Flighted on off, Karunaratne defends with soft hands towards cover and gets a single.
Tossed up on off, Perera comes down the track and strokes it to long off for one.
Flatter on off, KP blocks it calmly.

FOUR! Smart batting from Kusal Perera! Floated outside off, Kusal sees there is no one at deep backward square leg so he goes for the slog sweep. He does not time it well but it goes over the infield and races away to the fence.
Floated on middle, Kusal defends it off the front foot.
Fuller on middle and leg, Karunaratne flicks it to short mid-wicket. 8 runs off the over. Sri Lanka starting to pick momentum here.
Pulled hard but there is a man in the deep so just a single.
On the hips of Dimuth. He glances it to square leg and gets to the other end.
Fuller on off, Perera milks it to long off for a single.
Now flicks this one and gets a single. Sensible batting this from the Sri Lankan skipper.
FOUR! Punched and punched hard! Sarkar bowls it on a length and offers width to Karunaratne. Dimuth says thank you very much and smashes it through point for a boundary.
Flighted on off, Dimuth pushes it towards cover and keeps the strike.
Once again short from Mehedi. Perera cuts it to point and gets a single.
Tossed up on off, Karunaratne drives it to long off and rotates the strike.
Shorter on off, Perera punches it towards cover for a single.
Floated on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.

OHH! Almost beat him there. Short on middle and leg, it is bowled quicker.  Perera gets on his back foot and ends up getting a big chunk of the inner half of his bat. There is an appeal from the keeper but don't know for what...
Good length ball outside off, Karunaratne punches it but to cover.

Interesting! During the fall of the first wicket, the square leg umpire was gesturing that it's too high. But Nitin Menon had made his decision by then. Raveendra Wimalasari looked a shade disappointed as he turned his head sideways. The Hawk Eye though backed the original decision.
Uppish but safe. Full on middle and leg, Karunaratne flicks it uppishly but short of the man at mid on.

FOUR! Pulled in a controlled manner. Sarkar bowls a bouncer on middle, at Sarkar's pace it is an easy picking for Dimuth. He rocks onto his back foot and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. Poor delivery from Sarkar.
Outside off, Karunaratne has a go at it but misses.
Fuller on off, Karunaratne strokes it to mid off.
Soumya starts with a good length ball outside off, Kusal punches it to sweeper cover for a single.
Powerplay 2 signalled. Now 4 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over. Soumya Sarkar to inaugurate it.
On the pads, Karunaratne flicks it but straight to mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Perera comes down the track and milks it towards long off for a single.
Flighted on middle, DK milks it towards long on for one.
Once again short, this time Karunaratne defends it off his back foot.
Shorter on off, Karunaratne punches it to cover.
FOUR! Brilliant use of the feet and an excellent placement! It is the skipper this time. Floated on off, Karunaratne comes down the track and drives it through covers for a boundary.
On the pads, Karunaratne glances it towards square leg and keeps the strike with a single.
This keeps low. Good length ball outside off, Karunaratne goes for the drive but the ball keeps low which beats him. It goes to the keeper on a bounce too.
Now calmly follows it up with a flick towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Thrashed away! Overpitched outside off, Perera gets his front foot on the line and thrashes it through covers for a boundary.
On middle and leg, Kusal flicks it to mid-wicket.
On the fifth stump line, Perera throws his bat at it but misses.
Floated on off, Karunaratne drives it but straight to cover.
Full toss on off, Karunaratne misses out on it and ends up driving it straight to mid off.
Floated on off, Perera comes down the track and milks it down to long off for a single.
Shorter on off, Perera punches it straight to point.
FOUR! Lovely from Perera. Flighted on off, Kusal comes down the track and lofts it over mid off showing the full face of his bat.
Flighted delivery on middle, Karunaratne flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Full on off, Perera pushes it to mid off.
On the pads, Perera flicks it to the on side for a single.
Length delivery on top of off, Perera defends it off the back foot.
Now bowls it inside the tramline. Karunaratne runs it down to third man for a single.
WIDE! Shafiul bowls it way outside off. It is on the wrong side of the tramline and it has been wided.
Good length ball on middle and leg, Perera flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
Hit hard but straight to the fielder. Outside off on a length, Perera smacks it hard but straight to the man at point.
Loopy ball on middle, Perera flicks it towards mid-wicket and keeps the strike with a single.
Shorter around off, Perera blocks it off the back foot.
Floated on the stumps, KP defends it off the front foot.

Direct hit and Karunaratne was in trouble. Floated on off, Dimuth strokes it to the left of mid off and calls for a quick single. Tamim has a shy at the bowler's end but misses. Had he hit, Dimuth would have been in trouble as he was running diagonally.
Floated on the pads, Karunaratne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Starts with a shorter ball on off, Karunaratne punches it to cover.
Mehedi Hasan is into the attack.
Back of a length ball on off, Perera defends it off the back foot. A wicket maiden by Shafiul!

Ohh! Almost chopped on. Fuller ball on off, Perera comes down the track and looks to whack it on the off side but ends up getting an inside edge. Luckily it hits his pads and moves away from the leg pole.
Good length ball on off, Perera defends it off the front foot.
Kusal Perera is the new batsman in.

OUT! LBW! The Man of the Match from the last game does not make a big impact here. Bangladesh have struck early. Shafiul steams in and bowls an inswinging ball pitching around off. Avishka is hanging deep in the crease. He looks to defend but the inward movement beats him. The ball hits him on the back pad and Shafiul is confident that he has his man. Puts in a loud appeal along with his teammates. The umpire agrees and raises his finger. Avishka does not take it upstairs and the Ball Tracking shows that it's a good decision as the ball was going on to hit the middle stump.
Outside off and wide from the stumps, Avishka throws his bat at it but misses.
Good length ball on off, Avishka defends it off the back foot.
Floated on middle and leg, Karunaratne flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short on top of off, Avishka punches it towards long off for one.
On the pads, Karunaratne flicks it in a controlled manner towards mid-wicket for a single.

In the air but safe. This one spins and bounces. It is on middle and leg, Karunaratne looks to tuck it but the ball hits the higher part of his bat but luckily it falls short of the man at mid-wicket.
Once again short and this moves into the left-hander. Karunaratne tucks it towards mid-wicket.
Starts with a short ball on off, Fernando punches it towards cover and gets a single.
Change in bowling. Taijul Islam is into the attack now.
On a good length on off, Karunaratne blocks it off the back foot.
Good length delivery outside off, Karunaratne shoulders his arms to this one.
BEATEN! Islam bowls it on a good length and outside off, Karunaratne looks to defend but misses it due to the away movement on this one.
Good length delivery on leg, Karunaratne looks to flick but gets hit on the pads. The bowler appeals for lbw but the umpire shakes his head.
Full and outside off, Fernando drives it through covers. The fielder chases it and does well to stop it before the ropes. The batsmen get three runs.
On a good length on off, Fernando plays it to point.

FOUR! First one of the day and what a shot this is! Rubel is guilty of serving too many ball on the pads, Karunaratne picks it early and flicks it right off the meat of the bat through mid-wicket for a boundary.
On the pads, Karunaratne looks to flick but misses and the ball hits him high on the thigh pads.
Good length ball around off, Dimuth defends it off the back foot.
Avishka is off the mark. It is on the pads, Avishka flicks it to the on side and gets a single.
WIDE! It is way outside off, Avishka leaves it alone and the umpire signals it as wide.
First runs off the game. Good length ball on the pads, Karunaratne flicks it towards mid-wicket and gets a single to get the scoreboard ticking.
Good start from Rubel. He bowls it full on leg, Dimuth looks to flick but gets hit on the pads outside leg pole.
Rubel Hossain to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Back of a length ball on top of off, Avishka defends it. Maiden to start the game. Tidy bowling from Islam.
Now an away swinger. It is outside off, Avishka shoulders arms to it.
Nips back in. It is pitched on a length on off, Fernando looks to flick but he misses and the ball hits him high on the thigh pad. There are ohs and aahs from the Bangladesh players.
This is on off pole now and this time Avishka defends it with authority off his back foot towards cover.
Once again it is outside off but closer to the off pole. Avishka looks to defend but gets beaten.
Shafiul starts with a good length ball outside off. No movement for him first up. Avishka decides to leave it alone.

We are all set to begin. Sri Lanka skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne and Avishka Fernando walk out to open the innings for Sri Lanka. Shafiul Islam to start the proceedings with the first new ball. A slip in place for him.

PITCH REPORT - Russell Arnold says there is a good covering of grass and feels that there will be more runs on the board than the last game. Arnold reckons the side winning the toss will like to bat first. Reckons that the pitch will slow down after the first 10 overs and there will be turn on offer in the second innings. Thinks 270-280 is a winning total on this pitch.

Bangladesh skipper, Tamim admits they would have loved to bat first as well but tells the plan remains the same. Says in the last game they did not have a great start and they let themselves down. He feels that today they will put up a better show. On his team changes, Tamim informs us that Mustafizur has a niggle so he misses out along with Mosaddek Hossain.

Sri Lankan skipper Dimuth Karunaratne says that they are batting first as it looks like a good wicket and they want to take the advantage. Informs there are four changes in his side as they want to give chance to the youngsters. Says there is no change in the plan and they are looking to continue their good form.

Bangladesh Playing XI - Tamim Iqbal (C), Soumya Sarkar, Mohammad Mithun, Mushfiqur Rahim (WK), Mahmudullah, Anamul Haque (IN for Mosaddek Hossain), Sabbir Rahman, Mehedi Hasan, Shafiul Islam, Taijul Islam, Rubel Hossain (IN for Mustafizur Rahman).

Sri Lanka Playing XI -  Avishka Fernando, Dimuth Karunaratne (C), Kusal Perera (WK), Kusal Mendis, Angelo Mathews, Shehan Jayasuriya (IN for Lahiru Thirimanne), Dasun Shanaka (IN for Dhananjaya de Silva), Wanindu Hasaranga (IN for Isuru Udana), Akila Dananjaya, Kasun Rajitha (IN for Nuwan Pradeep), Lahiru Kumara.

TOSS - It is toss time here in Colombo for the 3rd and final ODI between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. Sri Lankan skipper, Dimuth Karunaratne has the coin in his hand. He tosses it up and it falls in favour of him. SRI LANKA OPT TO BAT!

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the third and final game between Sri Lanka and Bangladesh. The hosts who finally ended their bilateral series drought at home will now be looking to add cherry on top of it by clean sweeping the visitors. For the visitors, this has been a series to forget. They would like to get a consolation win here. Bangladesh skipper, Tamim Iqbal would be looking to end the series by getting some much-needed runs under his belt. The visitors will hope that others apart from the experienced Mushfiqur Rahim raise their hands up and put up an impressive show. Will the Lankan Lions completely demolish the Bangla Tigers or will there be a big roar from the Tigers? Stay tuned to find out as the toss is not far away.
